gen-gf-paprika-gf-blinker: Blinker reads friendly and tidy, its lines holding one thickness with open apertures and a lowercase that fills most of the height. Blinker keeps a long page easy on the eye, while Paprika up top lets its scattered, capital-sized lowercase do the shouting.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic: Loud up top, tidy below. Paprika spreads its capital-sized lowercase across the line with real swagger, while Carrois Gothic, a plain sans with a high-set x-height and generously opened c, does the quiet work of being read.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Contemporary all the way down. Carrois Gothic SC keeps capitals and lowercase nearly the same height, with curves left open at every end, and it can sit a touch larger than you'd expect beside Paprika.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-chivo: Paprika's lowercase swells to capital size and its letters sit scattered at a distance, which is the whole personality here. Chivo follows with lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight in every curve, so a long page stays friendly and easy to move through.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Modern and a bit bold in spirit, Paprika sprawls its capital-sized lowercase wide across the line. And Chocolate Classical Sans, a plain sans with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, carries a long page without tiring.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads like a round-tip marker, with wide-eyed e shapes, n arches as stout as their stems and a prominent x-height. Paprika is the one for commanding display work; Cossette Texte is the one for everything after.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads wide open, its small letters dominating the line while ascenders barely show. Giving it a little more size than usual would suit it next to Paprika, whose capital-sized lowercase is already loud.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-fresca: Modern and clean, Fresca drops all calligraphic thinning, so stems and arches match in thickness, with short ascenders over big bowls and counters kept open to the outside. Paprika's commanding scatter is the loud half, and Fresca's openness is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-funnel-sans: Paprika is commanding and expressive, with scattered letters and a lowercase that fills the line like capitals. And Funnel Sans answers with stroke widths that hold from stem to curve, tiny gaps under its ascenders and a wide-open e, drawn like fine wire.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-gafata: Big voice, tidy follow-up. Paprika scatters its capital-sized lowercase for pure presence, but Gafata, a sans-serif with a tall band of letters, short stalks above and wide-eyed e shapes, is built for the quieter job of being read.
